prompt: The House passes an AI bill, but the Senate has not considered it. Which description is accurate?

options.text: The bill has passed one chamber and has not become law.
options.explanation: House passage is one legislative milestone. Enactment still requires the remaining constitutional steps.

options.text: The bill automatically takes effect after thirty days.
options.explanation: There is no general rule that turns a House-passed bill into law after thirty days.

options.text: The President can sign the House version immediately.
options.explanation: Both chambers must agree to the same legislative text before it is presented to the President.

options.text: The Senate must accept the House text without changes.
options.explanation: The Senate can amend legislation. Differences between the chambers must then be resolved.

hint: Ask whether both chambers have agreed to the same text.
takeaway: A chamber's passage of a bill is distinct from enactment of a law.

sources.title: CRS: Introduction to the Legislative Process

prompt: After an AI law takes effect, a committee questions agency officials about its implementation. What function is the committee performing?

options.text: Judicial review of a constitutional challenge.
options.explanation: Courts resolve constitutional cases; a committee hearing is not a court judgment.

options.text: Congressional oversight of the executive branch.
options.explanation: Committees can examine how agencies carry out laws and use hearings to obtain information.

options.text: Automatic repeal of the implementation rules.
options.explanation: Questioning officials at a hearing does not itself repeal a law or agency rule.

options.text: Direct management of the agency's daily operations.
options.explanation: Oversight examines agency work; it does not transfer the agency's daily management to the committee.

hint: Congress continues to examine agency activity after legislation is enacted.
takeaway: Oversight is a continuing congressional function, including after a law takes effect.
